lifespan.source_note: ASICS generally recommends replacing running shoes every 300–500 miles, depending on the runner, surface, and wear. They do not publish a precise official mileage rating per model. This dashboard uses 400 miles as the typical midpoint, 300 as the check-for-wear mark, and 500 as the upper end of that range. Lifespan is an estimate, not a guarantee.

footnote: Running and walking miles count from each pair’s start date. Golf, cycling, hiking, and other activities are not added.
